newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Chinese military delegation to visit S.Korea.
newsitem.headline: Chinese military delegation to visit S.Korea.

text.p: A Chinese defence ministry delegation will discuss military cooperation with South Korean officials after arriving in Seoul on Saturday for an eight-day visit, a South Korean Foreign Ministry statement said on Sunday.
The delegation is headed by Luo Bin, director of the Chinese Defence Ministry's foreign affairs bureau and is the first of its kind to visit South Korea, the statement said.

The Chinese officials will meet Defence Minister Kim Dong-jin and other senior defence ministry officials to discuss security issues in northeast Asia and the Korean peninsula and promote bilateral military cooperation.
The ministry said the visit would contribute to fostering peace and stability on the peninsula, where a fragile ceasefire has kept the peace since the 1950-53 Korean War.
